# AUR packages installed with yay during the build (needs internet).
# One package name per line. Blank lines and #-comments are ignored.
#
# Note: superfile and lazygit both live in the official [extra] repository,
# so they are NOT listed here. yay is installed in the image so that this
# file, extra-aur.txt and your own RUN lines work out of the box.
#
# Do NOT edit this file to add your own packages -> use extra-aur.txt.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Upstream neofetch was archived in 2024 and dropped from the official Arch
# repositories; the AUR package is the only way to get the real thing.
# `fastfetch` (in packages/pacman.txt) is installed as a fallback and is used
# automatically by .bashrc/.zshrc if neofetch is unavailable.
neofetch
